Overview
Early-summer exploratory data analysis project investigating maternal healthcare disparities. This work was preparatory analysis that informed the broader CMU / Optum healthcare analytics research that followed later in the summer.

title: Maternal Healthcare Disparities — Exploratory Data Analysis
text:
What I did

Explored variable distributions, missingness patterns, and correlations in maternal health datasets.
Built ggplot2 visualizations to surface disparities by demographic and geographic dimensions.
Documented findings to inform downstream modeling decisions.

text: Role: Healthcare Analytics Research Intern · Carnegie Mellon University & UnitedHealth Group Optum Period: June 2025 – July 2025 · Pittsburgh, PA

title: U.S. County Healthcare Analytics — CMU / Optum
text:
Overview
Healthcare analytics research project investigating how demographic and social factors contribute to substance abuse outcomes — specifically drug overdose and alcohol-impaired driving deaths — using large-scale, county-level public health data.

title: U.S. County Healthcare Analytics — CMU / Optum
text:
What I did

Built and evaluated predictive models using LASSO, Random Forest, Elastic Net, and Huber regression across 3,000+ U.S. counties and 700+ variables to identify drivers of public health outcomes.
Cleaned, analyzed, and visualized large-scale healthcare datasets in R and Excel, including feature engineering and variable selection workflows.
Translated statistical findings into stakeholder-facing recommendations for healthcare strategy and planning.
Collaborated in a 3-person team under PhD mentorship through the SURE program.

    What I Do
    Focus areas
    I tend to live at the intersection of these four spaces. The common thread is using data and systems to help business operations run a little better.
  
  
    
      
      MIS & Enterprise Systems
      This is my home base. I've worked through SAP S/4HANA and SAP Fiori case work across procure-to-pay and order-to-cash, and I enjoy the requirements gathering, process modeling, and information flow side of MIS.
    
    
      
      Business Analytics & Data Visualization
      Predictive modeling, association rule mining, and dashboards in R, Python, SQL, Tableau, and Excel. I care most about making the output land with the people who actually have to use it.
    
    
      
      Supply Chain & Demand Planning
      Demand forecasting, inventory, and operations analysis. I'm comfortable using Forecast Value Added, wMAPE, RMSE, and tracking signals to look at whether a forecast is actually any good.
    
    
      
      Technology Consulting & Process Improvement
      I like sitting with stakeholders, watching how work actually happens, and finding the small process or technology change that takes the most friction out of their day.

Conclusion

There are regional differences in BMI
